items.definition:
the power or skill to do something
She has a great ability to learn new languages.

a person who trains a sports team or athlete
The football coach gave a motivational speech.

a group of things gathered together
He has a large collection of stamps.

a weapon that fires projectiles
The police officer carried a gun.

facts, information, and skills acquired through experience or education
He has a lot of knowledge about history.

an act of looking for something
The police conducted a thorough search of the area.

a topic or area of study
My favorite subject in school is science.

a writer of a book, article, or report
Who is the author of this book?

judge
The judge listened carefully to the arguments.

leader
She is a strong and inspiring leader.

material
What material is this shirt made of?

secretary
The secretary typed the letter.

unit
The apartment building has twenty units.

brain
The human brain is incredibly complex.

degree
She earned a degree in history.

image
The image on the screen was very clear.

opening
There's an opening for a new position at work.

opinion
What's your opinion on this matter?

a way of dealing with something; a path or road
We need a new approach to solve this problem.

the action of defending from attack; the system of protecting a country
The country's defense budget is very high.

the goods or merchandise kept on the premises of a business; shares of a company
The store has a large stock of new books.

a feeling of surprise and admiration; a remarkable thing
The Grand Canyon is a natural wonder.

a vigorous or determined attempt
It takes a lot of effort to learn a new language.

the state of being without or not having enough of something
There is a lack of funding for the project.

an organized body of people with a particular purpose; the action of organizing
She works for a non-profit organization.

a contest in which people try to win something
There is strong competition for the job.

a small part of something
He explained every detail of the plan.

the legally or formally recognized union of two people
Their marriage lasted for fifty years.

a person receiving medical treatment
The doctor visited the patient in the hospital.

the act or an instance of touching
He felt a light touch on his shoulder.

physical harm that impairs the value, usefulness, or normal function of something
The storm caused a lot of damage to the roof.

illness
The doctor diagnosed a rare disease.

uncertainty
There is no doubt about his honesty.

announcement, warning
There was a notice on the board.

university teacher
Professor Smith teaches history.

leader of a ship or team
The captain steered the ship through the storm.

illegal act
The police are investigating the crime.

place, mark
I found a good spot for a picnic.

guidance, recommendation
Can you give me some advice?

a mutual understanding or contract
We reached an agreement on the terms.

prize, honor
She won an award for her research.

a difficult task or problem
Learning a new language can be a real challenge.

the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism
All living things are made up of cells.

a medicine or other substance which has a physiological effect when ingested or otherwise introduced into the body
The doctor prescribed a drug for her headache.

the state of a country or region in terms of the production and consumption of goods and services and the supply of money
The global economy is facing many challenges.

a large number of people or things
A mass of people gathered in the square.

an important assignment carried out for political, religious, or commercial purposes, typically by a group of people
Their mission was to explore the new planet.

a type of popular music
She loves listening to pop music.

application
I downloaded a new app on my phone.

application
You need to fill out an application for the job.

liberty
Everyone deserves the right to freedom.

formal meeting
She had a job interview this morning.

effort, try
This is my first attempt at baking a cake.

a band of frequencies, a passage for water, a means of communication
What channel is the news on?

act of giving and receiving
We had a brief exchange of words.

the action of protecting, or the state of being protected
Wear a helmet for head protection.

the expression of thoughts and feelings in spoken words; a formal address
The president gave a powerful speech.

the movement of vehicles or people
The traffic was very heavy this morning.

an advantage or profit
There are many benefits to exercising regularly.

a strong request or need
There is a high demand for new smartphones.

a machine with moving parts that converts power into motion
The car's engine started making a strange noise.

a person who takes part in an undertaking with another or others
She is my business partner.

a means of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation
We need to find a solution to this problem.

a type of product manufactured by a particular company under a particular name
What brand of shoes do you prefer?
